mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate profits and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining GDP, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month signals deflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% each in a quarter signals strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate profits.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both increase > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 50,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of periods with increasing RSAFS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
